headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.variation_bind_ideal_support
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype D]
  (p q : OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.RationalLaw X)
  (K L : X → OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.RationalLaw D) (E : ℚ),
  (∀ (x : X), 0 < q.mass x → OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation (K x) (L x) ≤ E) →
    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw p K)
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw q L) ≤
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation p q + E

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualJoinedLaw_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    7 ≤ L →
      ∀
        (hp :
          2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
        (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit : ℕ),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit)
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.idealJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc hp d) ≤
          (1 / 2) ^ N + Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic hIn +
            Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.exitAllowance OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance J hExit

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.scheduledJoinedLaw_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    7 ≤ L →
      ∀
        (hp :
          2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
        (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (t : ℕ),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc d (t + 2) (t + 2)
              (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.attempts OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)
              (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.precision OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t))
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.idealJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc hp d) ≤
          Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t
